Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly identified the Demon Hunter as the class that casts "Metamorphosis". In World of Warcraft, the Demon Hunter ability is called "Demon Form" (or "Demon Form" for melee), whereas the class that casts the spell "Metamorphosis" is the **Druid**. This fundamental error led the agent to exclude the Druid from the DPS list and incorrectly include the Demon Hunter, resulting in a group composition that fails the "bear from the group is attacking" clue (since the Druid was needed for the bear form) and misidentifies the source of the Metamorphosis ability.
